_how_to_use: Flat dictionaries: call any dialogue by id anytime (scenes[id]). 'biomes' is an index: what each biome uses. Same id can be listed in several biomes.

start: I don't even know what I'm doing!
Let's just get this over with.
Alright, let's see if this wooden sword actually works.
win: I don't really know what is even going on.

attack: Take that, you weird pixel thing!
heal: Here, use this! Don't give up!
win: We make a good team, right?

low_hp: I thought we were a team... Why are you doing this to me?

attack: I'm really sorry, but if it wasn't me who attacked you, you would have attacked me first.
idle: This is wrong... This is all wrong.

taunt: She belongs to the system now! Leave her!
Are you going to risk your real life for a corrupt file?
If you touch her server, I'll disconnect you both!

apt_wake.t: Iker, how are you, son? It's been a long time since you wrote or called. I'm very worried. I miss you.
Same thing again. I can't deal with this right now. Better get the day started.

apt_breakfast.t: Just some cold cereal today. I really need to go grocery shopping.

apt_plant.t: Here you go, little guy. Please don't die on me yet.

apt_all_done.t: Well, everything's done. I must get ready to go to work.
But first I need to take all my clothes to the laundry shop.

apt_door.t: HUH? WHAT? WHAT IS GOING ON?
THIS THING IS ABSORBING ME! HELP! HELP!!! AGHHHHHH!

forest_arrive.t: Where am I? What is this place?

forest_slime_see.t: It looks like some kind of jelly. It looks harmless.
OH SHOOT, IT'S TRYING TO KILL ME!
Don't worry, warrior! Take this sword and make your way through all the enemies of this enchanted forest.
Where is that voice coming from?
Well, I'm just going to grab the sword and take this jelly thing out.

forest_hannah.t: Hey! Did you fall down here too?
Wait, you're human? Yeah... I was just in my hallway and now I'm fighting giant jelly things. I almost died already!
I know, right? I was literally just making breakfast and suddenly... boom. Just pixels everywhere. I'm Hannah, by the way.
Iker? That name sounds really familiar...
Do you have any idea what this place is? Is it some kind of VR game?
I have no clue. But I don't think we can just take off a headset to escape. That weird colorful voice earlier told me we need to 'advance through the forest'.
Advance? With these monsters walking around?
Exactly. But I figure we have a better chance if we stick together. If we team up, we'll find a way out faster.
Makes sense. Better than getting eaten by a slime on my own. Let's go.

rock_intro.t: Brave heroes! The path ahead is blocked. You must move that heavy rock to advance!
And don't forget to collect the Healing Fruit on the ground to restore your HP!

rock_done.t: Hello, Iker. Hello, Hannah. You have to follow my commands to get out of this loop. Trust me.
What was that, Iker? That voice... it didn't sound like the weird little guy from before. It gave me a real chill.
Yeah... 'trust me'? I don't like the sound of that at all. How does it know our names?
I don't know, but if it knows a way out of here, maybe we have to listen to it. What else can we do?
I guess... Let's just be careful and keep moving.

order1_potions.t: Inventory memory is overloaded. Drop all healing items immediately. They are slowing down the system.
Wait, drop our potions? But what if those glitched monsters attack us again?
Survival requires sacrifice. Drop them. Now.
Just do it, Hannah. We need to get out of here.

order2_path.t: Follow this specific path I've created. Any attempt to take another one will result in heavy consequences.
What consequences are you talking about?
Hannah, we need to escape this place. Just follow it.

order3_food.t: Inventory memory is overloaded. Drop all your food immediately. It is slowing down the system.
Wait, drop our food? But what if those glitched monsters attack us again?
Survival requires sacrifice. Drop it. Now.
Just do it, Hannah. We need to get out of here.

red_static_enter.t: Walk directly through the red static to reach the extraction point.
Are you crazy?! That looks like corrupted code. It's going to hurt us!
Do not look away. Do not stop walking. The pain is only simulated.

red_static_inside.t: Ah! Simulated?! It feels like my skin is burning!

green_door.t: I feel like my body is burning. It hurts a bit.
Yeah, but wait... what is that?
It looks like some kind of green door.
This is your longed-for exit. By passing through the green door, you will return to your normal lives.
We're finally going to escape, Iker!
Aagh. What the hell? Why can't we get out?
The path is closed. The system memory is full. To advance and escape, someone has to give up their code.
What do you mean? What does 'giving up their code' even mean? What do you want from us now?
The memory only allows one to enter.
Iker, you are stronger. I can read your stats in the code. Come on, you know you can do it. You know you want to escape, Iker.
FINISH HER. IT'S THE ONLY WAY.
What are you saying?! What do you mean?! Iker, say something! Do something, Iker!
DO IT DO IT DO IT
DO IT DO IT DO IT
DO IT DO IT DO IT

ending_good.t: TODO_LORE: hospital scene — Iker sees himself connected to machines.
